evidence_summary: Bupa Arabia's 2022 digital-transformation section states that big data and analytics enable the business to gain insights through analytics and artificial intelligence; the same section documents deployed customer-service chatbots.
source_locator: Annual Report 2022, Business Review, PDF p.29
adoption_interpretation: First observed explicit operational AI evidence in the currently audited 2022-2025 reports; treatment is left-censored until 2018-2021 reports are searched under the same protocol.
notes: Score 2 is conservative: operational use is explicit but the specific model architecture and decision scope are not disclosed.

evidence_summary: The Bupa mobile app reports an AI-powered symptom checker used for comprehensive health assessment, embedding AI directly in a member-facing healthcare product.
source_locator: Annual Report 2023, Customer Capital / mobile app, PDF p.32
adoption_interpretation: Confirms core product integration by 2023; treatment remains on after first observed deployment.
notes: Member-facing health assessment is part of the core insurance/health-service value proposition and meets the v0.2 core-integration threshold.

evidence_summary: Bupa Arabia reports using AI to automate cyber-threat detection and analysis for faster identification of suspicious activity.
source_locator: Annual Report 2023, Addressing cybersecurity, PDF p.29
adoption_interpretation: Independent operational AI use in cybersecurity; supports persistence across functions.
notes: Operational use is explicit but cybersecurity alone is coded 2 rather than 3 because it is a supporting control function.

evidence_summary: The 2024 Digital Clinic is described as leveraging AI-powered data-driven care to support doctors and patients across primary secondary and tertiary care.
source_locator: Annual Report 2024, Bupa App / Digital Clinic, PDF p.31
adoption_interpretation: Strong core-integration evidence in healthcare delivery; treatment remains on.
notes: The same page also reports an AI-powered symptom checker in the Bupa App.

evidence_summary: Bupa Arabia reports using AI for faster and more accurate cyber-threat identification.
source_locator: Annual Report 2024, cybersecurity measures, PDF p.29
adoption_interpretation: Confirms multi-function persistence of AI deployment in 2024.
notes: Kept as a separate evidence record from the core Digital Clinic use case.

evidence_summary: The 2025 report documents AI-powered personalized outreach for preventive programs and chronic care and AI-enabled risk prediction that automatically initiates outreach.
source_locator: Annual Report 2025, Engines of Value, PDF pp.25-27; official investor archive
adoption_interpretation: Mature core integration across healthcare engagement and risk prediction by 2025.
notes: Report also documents AI-powered health alerts and AI-enabled sourcing/screening in HR; only the core member-care use is used for this primary record.

evidence_summary: BSF's February 2026 Strategy 2030 announcement reports a 2025 baseline of fewer than five combined AI-and-analytics use cases and sets a 2030 target of 50+.
source_locator: BSF Strategy 2030 announcement dated 2026-02-16; Strategic Ambitions 2030 KPI table
adoption_interpretation: Retrospective evidence suggests some AI/analytics capability existed by 2025 but the combined metric does not establish that any specific use case was AI rather than advanced analytics. Keep below treatment threshold pending 2025 annual-report use-case evidence.
notes: Post-period publication reporting a 2025 baseline; do not treat as first-adoption evidence.
